## Problem

Is the request related to a problem? Describe it, e.g. "I'm always frustrated when ...".

## Proposed solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. If it is a UI feature, describe where
it should live (menu, toolbar, viewer, etc.). If it is a CLI/script feature, propose the verb and
arguments.

## Alternatives considered

Describe any alternative solutions or features you considered.

## Scope check

Check `D64Editor.App/Roadmap.md` and `AGENTS.md` to see whether the idea is already planned or
covered by an existing command.

## Additional context

Add any other context, example images, file formats, or screenshots that clarify the request.
